02

How we talk
about money

Stated up front so nobody wastes a call finding it out.

Productized tiers

A starting number, published

Launch Kit, Growth Engine and Content Machine carry a starting-at figure, because a number that filters saves both of us a meeting.

Custom work

No number, on purpose

Capability engagements and Strategic Partner are quoted after scope. Publishing a figure before scope anchors the conversation in the wrong place.

What we never do

No timers, no expiry

We flagged countdown pressure as a red flag in a client audit, so we do not run it on ourselves. The price is the price next Tuesday too.
